reference.title: The source process of the 2001 July 26 Skyros Island (Greece) earthquake

inversion.method: Empirical Green’s functions and inversion of source time functions; positivity and first-spatial-derivative smoothing constraints
inversion.green_function_model: Empirical Green’s functions from July 26 2001 M4.9 aftershock; half-space ray approximation
inversion.notes: Slip values approximate, digitized from grayscale Figure 6, with dark aftershock cubes and contour labels superimposed. A 50 x 30 km, 1 x 1 km subfault grid is described on page 546. Greyscale is matched to the 0–200 cm bar. The figure shows a smoothed plot; reconstructed 1500 values are not original inversion results. Geographic reference point and individual patch coordinates are not established, so geographic coordinates null. Depth_km calculated from down-dip location and nominal dip of 80 deg assuming upper edge at depth 0, not source-provided individual patch depths. Rake 8 deg is nominal fault-plane mechanism, not inverted per-patch rake. Fault strike-direction plot is N-NW to S-SE, matching strike 145° in opposite direction. Aftershock squares and grayscale overlap produce uncertainty. Paper reports ~1.8 m peak and ~0.23 m average slip over ruptured region; digitized estimates may differ.

provenance.compiled_by: Figure 6 grayscale digitization from user-provided image
